name: New York General Business Law Article 47 (§§ 1700–1704) — Artificial Intelligence Companion Models
description: New York state statute requiring operators of AI companion models to provide clear and conspicuous notice at the start of every interaction and at least every three hours during continuing interactions that the user is not communicating with a human, and to maintain suicidal-ideation and self-harm detection and crisis-service referral protocols.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by New York State (ny.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within New York State (ny.gov).
